verdict.rationale: Groq documents serving custom fine-tunes by letting users upload existing LoRA adapters and run inference on Groq infrastructure, so the serving half of the story is a first-party capability. The docs specify 'pre-made' adapters, and nothing in the pack shows Groq training a base model on user data, so the fine-tuning step must happen elsewhere. Missing for 10: on-platform fine-tuning or training jobs on user data, documentation of which base models support adapters, and independent or hands-on corroboration of LoRA serving.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can fine-tune a supported base model on my own data and serve the result on the same platform
